note: This file is committed BEFORE any holdout backtest is run. Thresholds marked 'tuned_on_dev' are selected on dev/validation seasons only and frozen before the holdout is evaluated once. Project-defined thresholds are not official NFL values and are labeled as such on the site.

gates.name: Provenance & integrity
gates.rule: All inputs carry source URL + commit SHA + sha256; integrity checks pass (no duplicate game_id, scores consistent with result/total fields, chronological order).

gates.name: Minimum sample
gates.rule: >= 300 settled holdout bets spanning >= 3 seasons. Project-defined threshold.

gates.name: Positive net ROI
gates.rule: Holdout ROI > 0 after vig using archived closing odds (default -110 per side when archive odds missing).

gates.name: Luck removal / significance
gates.rule: Week-clustered bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND matched-random permutation p < 0.05 AND Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 across all registered holdout trials.

gates.name: Robustness
gates.rule: Positive ROI in >= 60% of holdout seasons AND no single season contributes > 50% of total profit.

gates.name: No look-ahead
gates.rule: Every feature uses only games strictly before kickoff week; perturbation test (altering future results) leaves predictions unchanged.

gates.name: Pricing realism
gates.rule: Bets priced at archived closing lines/odds only. Parlay payout uses a verified sportsbook rule or a stated assumption flagged as unverified. Proxy markets (e.g., rolling-mean prop lines) FAIL G7 by construction.

gates.name: Forward replication
gates.rule: Prospective timestamped predictions logged for >= 1 full season and re-tested. Not yet satisfiable in this session; no strategy can be final-Gold until G8 passes.

tiers.Gold (provisional): G1-G7 all pass (G8 pending forward replication)
tiers.Silver: G1-G3 pass, raw significance passes but Holm or robustness fails
tiers.Bronze: G1-G3 pass, significance fails (edge indistinguishable from luck)
tiers.Research-only: G7 fails (proxy market or unverified pricing) regardless of ROI
tiers.Rejected: G3 fails (no positive net edge) or G1/G6 fails
tiers.Blocked: Required official/archived input unavailable; value left blank and flagged

rewards.type: non-monetary research points only; no money, no prizes funded
rewards.allocation: Split equally among strategies reaching Gold (provisional). If none pass, 0 points awarded and pool rolls over. Silver/Bronze earn leaderboard recognition only.

strategies_registered.rule: Bet the side whose model margin disagrees with archived closing spread by >= theta points. theta tuned on validation from {1.5, 2.5, 3.5}.
Bet over/under when model total disagrees with archived closing total by >= theta points. theta tuned on validation from {2.0, 3.0, 4.0}.
Bet ML when model win probability exceeds archived implied probability (vig-removed) by >= theta. theta tuned on validation from {0.03, 0.05, 0.07}.
2-leg parlay of two S1 selections from different games in the same week; standard 2-team parlay payout (verified or flagged). All pairs per week.
Favorite-cover + under / dog-cover + over joint probabilities vs product of marginals; fair-price monitor only. G7 fails unless official SGP prices archived (they are not).
Player yards over/under vs PROXY line = rolling 4-game mean (2021-2022 only). Research-only: G7 fails by construction.
Same-game QB passing yards + WR1 receiving yards joint over-probability vs independence; fair parlay multiplier from empirical joint. Research-only: G7 fails (no archived prop prices).
Always bet home favorite ATS at closing line (control).

forecast_skill_leaderboard: Separate from betting ROI: model forecast accuracy (MAE, RMSE, Brier/log-loss) vs naive baselines and vs market-implied forecasts. Beating naive baselines demonstrates modeling skill even when no betting edge exists at efficient closing lines.
